description: This file contains functions for processing, translating, and manipulating markdown documents with frontmatter tags, primarily for use in a documentation translation pipeline. It includes parsing, formatting, frontmatter encoding, and file I/O operations.

methods.name: processFileDoc
methods.description: Main function to process, translate, and save documentation files with frontmatter manipulation.

methods.name: splitFrontMatter
methods.description: Splits the document into frontmatter and body sections based on defined tags.

methods.name: buildFrontmatterTemplate
methods.description: Creates a template with markers for frontmatter fields, based on the provided data.

methods.name: applyFrontmatterTranslations
methods.description: Updates the frontmatter data with translated values using markers.

methods.name: parseTaggedDocument
methods.description: Extracts frontmatter and body content from a translated tagged document string.

methods.name: encodeFrontMatter
methods.description: Encodes the frontmatter data back into a string to include in the output document.

methods.name: resolveDocsPath
methods.description: Resolves the absolute and relative paths of documentation files within the docs root.
